 Spartanburg Water issues systemwide boil water advisory 
 Make sure to follow directions from officials if a boil-water advisory is issued for your area. By Mary Kate Howland Published : Nov. 18, 2026 at 9:37 AM EST | Updated : 1 hour ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google SPARTANBURG, S.C. (FOX Carolina) - Spartanburg Water is issuing a systemwide boil water advisory for all customers in the main Spartanburg Water system.
 Officials said that the advisory was issued due to a significant loss of water pressure and/or service throughout the distribution system. All customers except those in Landrum are being affected. 
 Spartanburg Water shared that while there has been no confirmed contamination of the system, customers are advised to vigorously boil their water for at least one full minute before drinking or cooking as a precaution. Any ice made from water that has not been boiled also should not be used for drinking purposes. 
 Officials said that the advisory will remain in effect until further notice.
 Spartanburg Water serves nearly 240,000 customers within Spartanburg County and other parts of the Upstate, though an exact number of how many customers this advisory affects is unknown. 
 Stay with FOX Carolina as we work to learn more.
